caseNameFull: SCHROEDER Et Al. v. WILLIAMS Et Al.
attorneys: James A. Lake, Sr. and Roy Harr op for appellants., Charles Thone and Clark O’Hanlon for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
